articles.title: Spain manager denies racism exists in the country
articles.summary: Spain manager Luis de la Fuente has claimed that there is no racism in Spain. His comments came in response to England coach Thomas Tuchel warning his players about protocols ahead of their upcoming Nations League match in Madrid.

articles.title: Chelsea defeat Manchester City to go top of WSL
articles.summary: Chelsea moved to the top of the Women's Super League after securing a narrow 1-0 victory against Manchester City. Manager Sonia Bompastor's tactical risks paid off, with Sandy Baltimore scoring a stunning goal in added time at the end of the first half to secure the crucial win.

articles.title: Former Stoke City manager Gudjon Thordarson dies at 71
articles.summary: Gudjon Thordarson, who famously guided Stoke City to promotion from the third tier in 2002, has passed away at the age of 71. During his managerial career, he also managed three other English clubs, leaving a notable legacy in English football.

articles.title: Tenerife boss reacts to Owono's 12-match ban
articles.summary: Tenerife manager Alvaro Cervera has spoken out after goalkeeper Jesus Owono received a 12-match ban. The suspension follows a tragic collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, as the club prepares for their next fixture.

articles.title: Declan Rice nearing new Arsenal contract agreement
articles.summary: Arsenal and England midfielder Declan Rice has revealed that he is currently close to signing a new contract with the North London club. The midfielder has been in stellar form for both club and country recently.

articles.title: Arsenal face £66m valuation for RB Leipzig's Nusa
articles.summary: Arsenal could be required to pay £66m to secure the services of RB Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa. Meanwhile, transfer gossip indicates that Real Betis have rejected an offer from Chelsea for Jose Morante, among other developing stories.

articles.title: Norway defeat Wales in Nations League encounter
articles.summary: Norway secured a victory over Wales in their Nations League fixture held in Oslo. The home side displayed clinical finishing to overcome Craig Bellamy's Welsh side, adding crucial points to their campaign in the tournament.

articles.title: Norway dent Wales Nations League top-tier hopes
articles.summary: Wales suffered a 3-1 defeat away to Norway in Oslo, damaging their chances of remaining in the top tier of the Nations League. Second-half goals from Antonio Nusa and Andreas Schjelderup within a span of nine minutes sealed the win for the hosts.

articles.title: De la Fuente insists Spain is free of racism
articles.summary: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has told England boss Thomas Tuchel that there is no racism in Spain. The comments arrived ahead of England's first game in Madrid since black players faced racist abuse during a match in 2004.

articles.title: Baltimore strike sends Chelsea top of WSL
articles.summary: A dogged performance and a brilliant late first-half strike from Sandy Baltimore gave Chelsea a 1-0 win over Manchester City. The victory allowed Sonia Bompastor's side to leapfrog their opponents and claim the top spot in the Women's Super League standings.

articles.title: Portugal immortalise Cristiano Ronaldo's number 7 shirt
articles.summary: Portugal have permanently preserved the original No 7 jersey design to honour Cristiano Ronaldo as a national legend. Ronaldo concluded his illustrious international career with 146 goals and three major titles across 246 appearances over 23 years.

articles.title: Brazil stunned by Japan as Raphinha sees red
articles.summary: Brazil suffered a 3-2 defeat against Japan in a friendly match in Singapore, which concluded in chaotic scenes. Barcelona captain Raphinha received a red card for protesting a late winner, and Brazil head coach Carlo Ancelotti was also sent off.

articles.title: John McGinn double rescues Scotland against North Macedonia
articles.summary: Scotland avoided an embarrassing result against North Macedonia thanks to two goals from midfielder John McGinn, including a crucial penalty. The match also marked Andy Robertson earning his 102nd cap, moving him level with Kenny Dalglish.

articles.title: Owono handed 12-match ban after fatal collision
articles.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 matches by the Spanish football federation. The ban follows his challenge on Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, which tragically resulted in the player's death during a second division match.

articles.title: Wales shock New Zealand to end historic win drought
articles.summary: Wales recorded a historic victory over New Zealand, beating the All Blacks for the first time since 1953. The remarkable performance and resilient defence sent shockwaves through the rugby world during the Nations Championship.

articles.title: Eddie Jones warns England ahead of All Blacks match
articles.summary: Former England head coach Eddie Jones praised his old team's performance after their 78-15 victory over Japan. However, he cautioned them that facing the All Blacks next week will be a much more violent challenge.

articles.title: Will Joseph scores five tries in England win over Japan
articles.summary: Will Joseph scored five tries on his return to the England team, helping Steve Borthwick's side crush Japan 78-15. The dominant display took place during Saturday's Nations Championship fixture.

articles.title: Tuchel frustrated by anti-racism protocol questions
articles.summary: Thomas Tuchel expressed frustration that his comments regarding anti-racism protocols were twisted. The controversy overshadowed the build-up to England's high-profile Nations League clash against Spain in Madrid.

articles.title: Wales face relegation threat after defeat in Norway
articles.summary: Craig Bellamy's Wales side suffered a 3-1 defeat against Norway in Oslo. Despite a spirited effort from the visitors, the loss leaves them facing a growing threat of relegation to the second tier of the Nations League.

articles.title: Late Kalajdzic goal sinks Republic of Ireland in Austria
articles.summary: The Republic of Ireland fell to a late defeat in Linz as Sasa Kalajdzic scored the only goal of the game. Austria claimed a 1-0 victory in their Nations League fixture at the Raiffeisen Arena.

articles.title: Wales secure first win against New Zealand since 1953
articles.summary: Wales produced one of the biggest shocks in modern rugby by defeating New Zealand 35-28 in the Nations Championship. An immense defensive effort carried the team to their first victory over the All Blacks in over seventy years.
